publisher: Universiti Tun Hussein Onn Malaysia, Journal of Advanced Industrial Technology and Application
title: Development of Eggshell Powder Potential in Claypot for Water Filtration Process for Rural Dwellers in Nigeria
scope: 12-page publisher PDF text; methods and results pp31–37 read. Not quantitative drying-curve data.
supports: Experimental clay/eggshell pots were bagged for 4–5 days to slow drying; 600 micrometre eggshell blends still cracked early. Changing mixture and particle size changed cracking even under the same stated laboratory regime.
doesNotVerify: High-eggshell filter pots differ from island clay. Bagging duration is not proved time-to-dry. Sample count and mass/dimension time series not acquired; no transferable 60% crack probability or leaves factor.

evidence.shortExcerpt: Specimens were constantly monitored for onset of cracks on the prototype clay pot.
